problems.title: Add Two Numbers
problems.description:
Write a program that takes two integers $A$ and $B$ from standard input and prints their sum.

### Task
Read two space-separated integers $A$ and $B$, compute $A + B$, and output the result.
problems.input_format: A single line containing two space-separated integers $A$ and $B$.
problems.output_format: Print a single integer representing the sum $A + B$.

starter_code.python:
# Read two space-separated integers
a, b = map(int, input().split())
print(a + b)

problems.title: Even or Odd Number
problems.description:
Given an integer $N$, determine whether the number is **Even** or **Odd**.

Print `Even` if the integer is divisible by 2 with remainder 0, otherwise print `Odd`.

sample_tests.explanation: 7 leaves a remainder of 1 when divided by 2.

problems.title: Palindrome String Checker
problems.description:
A palindrome is a word, phrase, or sequence that reads the same backward as forward.

Given a single string $S$ consisting of alphanumeric characters, determine if it is a palindrome. Case-sensitive.

Print `YES` if it is a palindrome, otherwise print `NO`.
problems.input_format: A single string $S$ with no internal spaces.

problems.title: Factorial of a Number
problems.description:
Compute $N!$ (N factorial) for a non-negative integer $N$.

Recall that $0! = 1$ and for $N > 0$, $N! = 1 \times 2 \times 3 \times ... \times N$.

problems.title: Nth Fibonacci Number
problems.description:
The Fibonacci sequence is defined as:
- $F(0) = 0$
- $F(1) = 1$
- $F(n) = F(n-1) + F(n-2)$ for $n \ge 2$.

Given $N$, compute $F(N)$.

problems.title: Prime Number Detection
problems.description:
A prime number is a natural number greater than 1 that has no positive divisors other than 1 and itself.

Given an integer $N$, determine if it is a prime number. Output `PRIME` or `NOT PRIME`.

problems.title: Find Maximum Element in Array
problems.description: Given an array of $N$ integers, find and print the maximum value in the array.
problems.input_format:
The first line contains an integer $N$.
The second line contains $N$ space-separated integers.
problems.output_format: Print the maximum value present in the array.

starter_code.python:
n = int(input().strip())
arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
print(max(arr))

sample_tests.explanation: 99 is the highest integer in the array.

problems.title: Sort Numbers in Ascending Order
problems.description: Given an unsorted array of $N$ integers, sort the array in ascending order and print the elements separated by spaces.
problems.input_format:
The first line contains $N$.
The second line contains $N$ space-separated integers.
problems.output_format: Print the sorted array elements on a single line separated by spaces.

starter_code.python:
n = int(input().strip())
arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
arr.sort()
print(" ".join(map(str, arr)))

problems.title: Binary Search Target Index
problems.description:
Given a strictly increasing sorted array of $N$ integers and a target value $K$, return the 0-based index of $K$ in the array.

If $K$ does not exist in the array, print `-1`. You must implement $O(\log N)$ binary search.
problems.input_format:
The first line contains $N$ and $K$.
The second line contains $N$ sorted integers.
problems.output_format: Print the 0-based index of $K$, or -1 if not found.

starter_code.python:
import bisect
n, k = map(int, input().split())
arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
idx = bisect.bisect_left(arr, k)
if idx < n and arr[idx] == k:
    print(idx)
else:
    print(-1)

problems.title: Matrix Transpose
problems.description:
Given an $R \times C$ matrix of integers, output the transpose matrix of size $C \times R$.

The transpose of a matrix is formed by turning rows into columns and columns into rows.
problems.input_format:
The first line contains $R$ and $C$.
The next $R$ lines each contain $C$ space-separated integers.
problems.output_format: Print $C$ lines, each containing $R$ space-separated integers.

starter_code.python:
r, c = map(int, input().split())
matrix = [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(r)]
for j in range(c):
    row = [str(matrix[i][j]) for i in range(r)]
    print(" ".join(row))

sample_tests.explanation: The 2x3 matrix is transposed into a 3x2 matrix.
